mono.usage: Data tables, smart contracts, ledgers, audit trails

layout_and_spacing.marketing: Asymmetric, The Swiss Grid, overlapping elements. Generous padding: p-12, p-24, p-32.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard: Bento Grid (Control Room Mode). Dense data structures. Use grid-cols-4 or grid-cols-12 for complex layouts. Tight padding: p-4, p-6.

components.buttons: Flat solid or ghost. No heavy gradients. 1px border for secondary. Primary button is Cinematic Bronze with black text.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: border color lightens. DO NOT use Shadcn Card heavily for marketing; use purely custom divs.
components.inputs: Dark background inputs, 1px white/10 border. Focus state: white/30 border ring.
components.navigation: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with 1px bottom border border-white/10.
components.data_tables: Cardless design. Flush to container edges. 1px bottom borders for rows. JetBrains Mono for figures.

motion.marketing: Lenis smooth scroll. Framer motion reveal on scroll. Slow organic marquee for investor logos.
motion.dashboards: Minimalist micro-interactions. Fast state changes. Hover highlights. No heavy page transitions.

hero_background.description: Abstract cinematic financial data visualization for main landing page hero

producer_dashboard_bg.description: High-end cinema camera lens reflecting data - use for Producer Dashboard or Features section

investor_dashboard_bg.description: Monumental Web3 ledger representation - use for Investor Dashboard or Rights Ledger section

specific_sections.marketing_hero: Use hero_background with black/40 overlay. H1 text-6xl+ tracking-tight in Cabinet Grotesk. CTA button Cinematic Bronze. Use 'Tracing Beam' or subtle 'Glassmorphism' for a floating intro card.
specific_sections.producer_dashboard: Control room grid. High density. Minimal margins. JetBrains mono for Cap Tables and SPVs. Use Shadcn tables but customize to be cardless.
specific_sections.investor_dashboard: Use investor_dashboard_bg as a very subtle faded background or header art. Emphasize ROI with charts (Recharts) using Bronze and White lines on deep dark backgrounds. No teal/green for positive numbers, use Signal White or Gold.
specific_sections.rights_management: Simulate ledger entries using monospace font. Left align data. Strict column widths.
specific_sections.supply_chain_intelligence: Use Recharts or React Force Graph 3D for vendor mapping. Data nodes should glow in Gold and White.
specific_sections.admin_panel: Standard dense table layouts. Functional, 1px white/10 borders.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme and Archetype 5 (Luxury/Cinematic).
DO NOT use Inter, Space Grotesk, or Roboto fonts.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons for UI elements.
Never use purple or teal. If data visualization needs positive/negative, use Gold/White vs Muted Crimson.
Do not use generic placeholder image URLs. Use the exact URLs provided in this JSON.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling on the landing page.
Use framer-motion for page transitions and micro-interactions.
All components must use standard Tailwind CSS classes matching these colors.
For UI files, the project uses .js/.jsx, so do not generate .tsx files.
